_notes: Fixed park facilities (M2.5; replaces buildings.json). Each exists at tier 0 from day one at the world position given in parcels.json. Tiers 1-3 are bought in order from the General Store -> Upgrades tab. effect_magnitude is the ABSOLUTE effect at that tier (not an increment): parking_capacity = extra visitors/day above front_gate_capacity; concession_spend = multiplier on balance.revenue.per_visitor_concession_spend (food + gift add together, still needs concessions staff); satisfaction = added visitor satisfaction (raises price tolerance, capped by balance.attendance.satisfaction_price_tolerance_cap). render_size is visual only: lot = {w, rows} in world units / car rows; building = {w, h, z, roofs} footprint scale, height, and roof sections.

facilities.name: Parking Lot
facilities.blurb: The front lot. Every visitor beyond the front gate limit needs a parking space, so a bigger lot raises the daily visitor cap.

facilities.name: Restrooms
facilities.blurb: Near the plaza. Better restrooms keep visitors in the park longer and make them accept a higher ticket price.

facilities.name: Food Stand
facilities.blurb: On the plaza edge. Sells snacks, then meals as it grows into a diner. Needs a concessions worker to open.

facilities.name: Gift Shop
facilities.blurb: Near the gate, so everyone walks past it on the way out. Souvenirs earn more per visitor than snacks. Needs a concessions worker to open.

facilities.name: Park Office
facilities.blurb: Where your staff clock in. Base building only for now; office upgrades are planned for a later milestone.
